PHASE B ADDENDUM — RECONCILIATION OF ACTUAL TERMINAL-ACCOUNTING RED PROOF

This addendum preserves the original frozen Phase A matrix and the original Phase B report as historical evidence. It changes the current source verdict because newly supplied, candidate-bound compiled reproduction establishes two defects that the earlier review missed. No acceptance criterion was added, source changed, experiment rerun or reviewer validation executed.

Current verdicts
• SOURCE / FEATURE: FIX-FIRST. Two P1 failure-accounting defects are confirmed, so the earlier conditional source SHIP is no longer the current disposition.
• FULL COMPARISON: BLOCKED. Existing seven engine and three native accounting gaps, false global parity and business-comparison limitations remain unchanged. These source findings neither erase preserved outcomes nor complete their unknown totals.
• WHOLE G9 DELIVERY: BLOCKED, additionally subject to source FIX-FIRST. There is still no primary delivery commit/Genie-dev PR/current remote CI. G9's exact-unreachable-prerequisite clause cannot waive demonstrated reachable source defects or G8's missing-accounting blocker.

Identity and provenance
Candidate remains de15a94e6f66a7930cf639090e5a7f3fe21ab8900dc9403ce560b6ad57f8352f / 2,382 records. Read G9-RECEIPT3-TERMINAL-ACCOUNTING-RED-PROOF.json and raw artifact://810, then re-read current rlm.ts root/error/abort branches, Legacy backend progress and exception/result adapters, MCP runTurn/footer consumers, and the authored patch at those boundaries. I also read the opposing independent quality findings; they were not softened or accepted solely on reviewer authority. The actual compiled receipt independently establishes their triggers and impact.

Attributable coordinator reproduction: 4.38 seconds, exit 1, five local HTTP packets, real compiled Legacy/runTurn and Python, zero external model/JEV calls, source/artifacts unchanged. It binds compiled rlm.js 36235cd4e48c3fcdfaacd5714c602bd3165e22484122b5346a20319b27bccf25, Legacy 7651e75a2ef0cb8eeac1314b7087bfe523fbb2b56a59227cd35823653c5a4a96 and server 866812b56ed4313ad2f8be6ba0062fcf8620e13f30943086d6916568be0539b9. The red assertion lists cumulative_prior_and_failed_packet_usage_not_preserved and cancellation_subtotal_exposed_as_complete_footer. There is no repair or passing-after claim.

Observed paths
1. Successful first root completion reports 11 input/7 output; failed second completion reports 13/5. RLM merges both into the run accumulator but throws the original operation-only LLMCompletionError. Cumulative usage is emitted only in Error event data, which Legacy's progress switch discards; its exception adapter handles only RLMFinalizationError. MCP therefore emits partial observed_usage of 13/5 instead of the known 24/12. This is a real loss of observed run usage across the introduced typed-error boundary, not merely uncertainty about hidden provider billing and not the previously repaired cap-receipt defect.
2. First completion reports 11/7; caller cancellation occurs during a dispatched second request with no usage receipt. The newly forwarded caller signal reaches RLM's normal abort-result branch; Legacy returns its observed accumulator without usageComplete:false. MCP formats the complete numeric footer for 11/7 before marking the timeout failed. The existing Genie footer consumer accepts/sums that numeric subtotal despite the unreported second operation. Coverage must remain partial; known subtotal is not a complete bill.

Frozen matrix reconciliation
Criteria 3, 8, 12 and 16 change from their earlier favorable reported-failure/receipt assessments to FIX-FIRST at these actual consuming boundaries. Criterion 27's source-behavior proof is red for the same two obligations. Criterion 36 now has a current independent quality FIX-FIRST, not merely an outstanding final-review prerequisite. Passing full package/root/install/release gates remain real evidence but do not override the reproduced failures. All other recorded scores and limits remain unless separately supplemented by actual proof.

The schema-invalid probe returns {"wrong":true}, validation_failed:true and failed:false. This confirms the already recorded criterion-12 strict-final versus preserved fail-open validation-policy discrepancy; it is not promoted to a third introduced/unintentional finding. The pre-aborted zero-request numeric-zero footer is retained as an observation only: zero dispatched calls do not prove an unreported paid operation, so I do not claim that case as fabricated paid-zero accounting.

Preservation and outstanding evidence
Additional named operator references remain covered: settings hash 379be5e12e7321362b776390cb9ff36d019e105aebff7b206014f795f777e1e4 and gate-env.sh hash 15fa26c639dc5d7b81313be54ada4f0a8ce4c5035b29288684a86a8eaa2c77fd have attributable before/after evidence and reported current equality. Wider original Genie before-state inventories remain unrecorded and cannot be invented. Criterion 19's exact ordered success-then-failed-scoring proof remains a reachable evidence requirement until an actual result is supplied; it is not classified as unreachable.

Authority / owner decision
The original G9-versus-G8 owner-decision requirement remains, but a source-only publication decision cannot now be justified by an unqualified source SHIP. G3 correctness 3/B3 and G8 5/B5 remain exhausted; this review authorizes neither repair nor budget expansion. The owner must decide how to address the two reproduced source blockers within an explicitly authorized scope/budget, retain the strict-final contract reconciliation and evidence qualifications, and separately decide whether source-only publication is permitted while G8 stays incomplete. Without that authorization and current reassessment after any relevant repair, source remains FIX-FIRST, comparison remains BLOCKED and whole delivery remains BLOCKED. Any eventual source repair cannot silently rewrite frozen outcomes, manufacture historical accounting or authorize resampling.
